title: Implement text statistics functions in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement word_count, char_count, avg_word_length, most_common_words, and sentence_count functions for basic text analysis.

injections.content:
from src.text_stats import word_count, char_count, avg_word_length, most_common_words, sentence_count


def test_word_count():
    assert word_count("hello world") == 2
    assert word_count("  one  two  three  ") == 3
    assert word_count("") == 0


def test_char_count():
    assert char_count("hello world") == 10
    assert char_count("") == 0


def test_avg_word_length():
    assert avg_word_length("hi there") == 3.5
    assert avg_word_length("") == 0.0


def test_most_common_words():
    text = "the cat sat on the mat the cat"
    result = most_common_words(text, 2)
    assert result == ["the", "cat"]


def test_sentence_count():
    assert sentence_count("Hello! How are you? I am fine.") == 3
    assert sentence_count("No punctuation here") == 0
    assert sentence_count("") == 0

required_artifacts: word_count uses str.split() with no args to handle multiple spaces
most_common_words uses collections.Counter and re.findall for word extraction
sentence_count counts . ! ? with re.findall or similar
